prompt: A tight three-quarter close-up from just above the bed of a heavy 1920s flatbed printing press in a low brick cellar, shot on a short macro-like lens. Steel rollers and black ink plates fill the foreground. A sheet of banknotes, printed with fine dark green engraving and no legible figures or words, lifts off the bed in mid-air, more stacked behind. The far end of the machine is on fire: orange flames licking at the frame, reflected long and rippling in the polished steel. Deep indigo shadow in the cellar. Nobody in the shot. Thanks.
